rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for general guidance, direction, or non-specialized advice.

example.english: I need some guidance; I don't know how to get there the first time.
example.traditional: 我想請你畀我啲指引，第一次去嗰度唔知點行。
example.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 cing2 nei5 bei2 ngo5 di1 zi2 jan5 dai6 jat1 ci3 heoi3 go2 dou6 m4 zi1 dim2 haang4

rows.note: Use this for guidance or instruction given by a teacher, expert, or authority rather than simple advice.

example.english: The professor gives us professional guidance in class.
example.traditional: 教授會喺課堂上畀我哋專業指導。
example.jyutping: gaau3 sau6 wui5 hai2 fo3 tong4 soeng6 bei2 ngo5 dei6 zyun1 jip6 zi2 dou6

rows.note: Use this specifically for counselling or supportive guidance, such as educational, career, or psychological counselling.

example.english: I saw a guidance counsellor to discuss further studies.
example.traditional: 我搵咗輔導老師，想同我傾升學。
example.jyutping: ngo5 wan2 zo2 fu6 dou6 lou5 si1 soeng2 tung4 ngo5 king1 sing1 hok6

rows.note: Use this for the technical guidance of a missile, vehicle, or other system along a controlled path.

example.english: This guidance system can control the missile to fly along the designated route.
example.traditional: 呢套制導系統可以控制導彈沿住指定航線飛行。
example.jyutping: ni1 tou3 zai3 dou6 hai6 tung2 ho2 ji5 hung3 zai3 dou6 daan6 jyun4 zyu6 zi2 ding6 hong4 sin3 fei1 hang4
